skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attacks a single target for 120% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals damage to each enemy in a row with 5 consecutive strikes that deal 130% ATK(+XX) DMG, with a 50% chance to afflict the main target with [Stun] for 1 round (cannot take action and this effect is not affected by Hit). Dealing Crit DMG afflicts the target with [Shatter] for 2 rounds (receives 30% more DMG).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals damage to each enemy in a row with 5 consecutive strikes that deal 130% > 165% ATK(+XX) DMG, with a 50% chance to afflict the main target with [Stun] for 1 round (cannot take action and this effect is not affected by Hit). Dealing Crit DMG afflicts the target with [Shatter] for 2 rounds (receives 30% > 40% more DMG).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Every time Child Emperor finishes his action, allies in the same row enter [Berserk] state for 1 round (DMG increases by 30%). Permanently increases HP.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Every time Child Emperor finishes his action, allies in the same row enter [Berserk] state for 1 round (DMG increases by 45%). Permanently increases HP.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Every time Child Emperor finishes his action, allies in the same row enter [Berserk] state for 1 round (DMG increases by 50%). Permanently increases HP.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Attack buffs increase damage based on conditions (e.g. each marked enemy), amplifying the amount of Fury-type damage the unit deals.
